questions.question: What is the correct order for applying temperature in sampling?
choices: Apply softmax first, then divide probabilities by temperature
Divide logits by temperature, then apply softmax
Apply temperature as a post-processing step after sampling
Temperature doesn't affect the sampling process
questions.explanation: Temperature must be applied to raw logits BEFORE softmax. Applying it after softmax gives the opposite effect (flatter distribution instead of sharper).

questions.question: What happens when temperature = 0 in sampling?
choices: The model crashes with a division by zero error
The sampling becomes greedy (always picks the highest logit)
The model generates completely random output
questions.explanation: Temperature 0 makes the distribution infinitely sharp — the highest logit gets probability 1, everything else gets 0. This is equivalent to greedy sampling.

questions.question: How does top-p (nucleus) sampling differ from top-k?
choices: Top-p is always faster than top-k
Top-p selects a dynamic number of tokens based on cumulative probability
Top-p uses a fixed number of tokens like top-k
questions.explanation: Top-p accumulates tokens by probability until reaching threshold p, making the candidate set dynamic. Top-k always keeps exactly k tokens regardless of their probabilities.
